SELECT
  a.District,
  b."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" - a."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS points_change
FROM district_health_factsheet a
JOIN district_health_factsheet b
  ON a.District = b.District
  AND a.State = b.State
  AND a."Survey Round" < b."Survey Round"
WHERE a.State = 'Bihar'
